raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 payments-source sends amount corrections as new rows with the same txn_id and record_version 2, and silver_transactions keeps every version, so 25 txn_ids are duplicated. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id (highest record_version, then latest ingest_ts and batch_id) before the POSTED filter, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
